strategy.text:
(1) ATTACK? Pelipper (Drizzle lead) likely to U-turn (keep rain/momentum) or rain-boosted Hydro Pump/Scald/Hurricane. Expect U-turn or Hydro Pump ~60/40.
(2) SWITCH? It just switched in to set rain; probably stays or U-turns, not a hard switch. Its own switch target would be Claydol (100%).
(3) THEIR READ: only knows Weezing-Galar (Poison/Fairy, Levitate, Black Sludge); wants to preserve Pelipper for rain.
(4) OPTIONS & SWITCH COST: Rotom-Heat Water-weak (2x, bad). Noivern neutral but no supereffective hit (Fire Blast nerfed in rain, Draco neutral). Toxtricity: Electric/Poison neutral to both STABs; Wild Charge = guaranteed 4x OHKO (203-239%). COST: forfeit turn, eats 81-96% from rain Hydro Pump (survives, but very low) or neutral U-turn. GAIN: forces Pelipper out or KOs it = big momentum vs rain core. Toxtricity outspeeds (249>166) and OHKOs, so net sound; only a crit + SpA-invested Hydro Pump risks a KO on switch-in.
(5) MOST LIKELY + RESPONSE: Pelipper U-turns/Hydro Pumps; I switch Toxtricity, survive, next turn outspeed + OHKO. Falsifier: Hydro Pump crit KOs Toxtricity on entry.
(6) SEQUENCE: Toxtricity in (eats 81-96% or U-turn). Next turn outspeed + Wild Charge OHKO. If Pelipper U-turned, I face a fresh mon at ~10-20% and must switch/sacrifice.

Noivern lacks Electric. Steadiest: stay in Weezing, Sludge Bomb 37-43% + 30% poison; Weezing survives Scald (max 95%, Black Sludge recovers). (6) SEQUENCE: Pelipper Scald 81-95% (Weezing survives) OR U-turn to rain mon; then Sludge Bomb 37-43%; next turn reassess.

strategy.text:
(1) ATTACK? Pelipper is a rain setter; likely clicks Hurricane (100% acc in rain) or Scald/Hydro Pump/U-turn. It doesn't know my team, so it plays its own role: set rain and pivot/dent. Moderate confidence on Hurricane or U-turn.
(2) SWITCH? Possibly U-turn into Claydol or a swift swim threat. But it just switched in, so it likely stays to attack or pivot next turn.
(3) THEIR READ OF ME: knows only Weezing-Galar (Levitate, Defog-ish). Doesn't know my Electric threats.
(4) MY OPTIONS & SWITCH COST: Rotom-Heat switch-in survives any single Pelipper hit easily (Hurricane 22-27%, Scald in rain ~48% at worst) and its Thunderbolt OHKOs Pelipper (217-257%). Cost = forfeit turn + eat one hit; gain = immediate 4x OHKO threat on their rain setter. Confident in surviving safely (bulky + Levitate ignores Ground coverage). Not behind; this is a strong pivot.
(5) MOST LIKELY ACTION + RESPONSE: Pelipper likely Hurricane/U-turn; I switch to Rotom-Heat, threaten Thunderbolt OHKO (or Volt Switch pivot out if it stays locked vs a Ground switch-in).
(6) SEQUENCE: Pelipper acts (Hurricane/Scald/U-turn on Rotom-Heat 22-48%) -> Rotom-Heat in safely -> next turn I click Thunderbolt/Volt Switch. Falsifier: if Pelipper clicks a move that KOes Rotom-Heat (it won't).
